newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil diffs firm on first day of new diesel.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil diffs firm on first day of new diesel.

text.p: NWE gas oil premiums were steady to firm on Tuesday with short-term physical fundamentals still tight, but outright prices fell in line with underlying IPE futures.
IPE Oct futures shed $2.50 to trade at $230 at 1150 GMT and the Nov contract was also down $2.50 at 220.50 a tonne, weakened by increased speculation over the resumption of Iraqi oil exports.
Tightness in the diesel market on the first day that EU filling stations must sell diesel with a maximum sulphur content of 0.05 pct pushed up barge premiums to Oct IPE +$17 fob ARA.
Diesel cargoes talked around Nov IPE +$18/$20 after a small parcel traded into Rostock on Monday at Nov +$20.50 cif NWE.
Heating oil premiums held their ground with the drop in futures tempting a few buyers back to the market.
A prompt Rotterdam refinery barge traded at Oct IPE +$8.50 fob Rotterdam. Second half October heat barges were offered at Oct +$2 but bids were scarce.
A German refiner seeking a mid-month heating oil cargo was bidding at Nov IPE +$6/$8.
